  orphan: defineTable({
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
  }),

  priority: defineTable({

  }),

  ticket: defineTable({
    channels: v.array(v.string()), // enum -> option set (member values not in IR)
    priority: v.string(), // enum -> option set (member values not in IR)
    bubbleId: v.string(), // primary key (Bubble _id, text)
